items.title: The Steam Deck's Screen Now Works on a Raspberry Pi
items.description: You can use the Steam Deck's touchscreen LCD with a Raspberry Pi thanks to this HAT. Thanks to Scandent for open sourcing their design and code to make this work! items.title: Now you can build your own Raspberry Pi factory
items.description: Raspberry Pi sent me a little piece of a Pi Factory—a CM5 Programming Jig! You can buy one too; they're $600. Not that many people watching this will ever need one, especially considering CM5 pricing lately due to DRAM price shenanigans :( It's interesting nonetheless, so watch as I try using it with a couple of my CM5s! items.title: Rendering on Arm Linux is faster, cheaper (and possible now)
items.description: SideFX added Arm Linux support to Houdini 22 as a 'Technology Preview'. It's not meant for full production workflows quite yet. But I'm guessing people will flock to Arm pretty quickly if they can realize time and cost savings for compute! Thanks to SideFX for reaching out and letting me play with early preview builds before launching Houdini 22; if you're interested, read more here: https://www.sidefx.com The video also has a brief clip from this neat VFX reel from Outpost VFX, worth a watch if you want to see a modern compositing/rendering workflow: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gHsHgDMeYwc Support me on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/geerlingguy Sponsor me on GitHub: https://github.com/sponsors/geerlingguy Merch: https://www.redshirtjeff.com 3rd Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@JeffGeerling 2nd Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@GeerlingEngineering

items.title: Telstra had a REALLY bad time last week
items.description: Telstra (sorry for the mispronunciation, I always read it 'Telestra' lol) had a terrible time last week. In fact, they were temporarily 20 years behind the times! Why did this happen, and how could they have avoided it? Let's take a quick look into timing history to find out. - Information Age Article: https://ia.acs.org.au/article/2026/telstra-outage-blamed-on-known-bug-in-obsolete-server.html - Guardian Article: https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/10/telstra-ceo-deeply-sorry-for-outage-and-admits-risk-of-time-keeping-failure-was-known-ntwnfb - Financial Review Article: https://www.afr.com/companies/telecommunications/trains-halted-as-telstra-mobile-outage-sweeps-nation-20260708-p60dik - Discussion of GPS 1024 week rollover bug on the Time Nuts mailing list: https://febo.com/pipermail/time-nuts_lists.febo.com/2026-July/110851.html Support me on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/geerlingguy Sponsor me on GitHub: https://github.com/sponsors/geerlingguy Merch: https://www.redshirtjeff.com Main Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@JeffGeerling 2nd Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@GeerlingEngineering

items.title: Remote control 4 computers, anywhere (ft Comet X)
items.description: Now I can control my entire cluster of Xserves! Note: GL-iNet sent this Comet X unit for testing and review (it was an early production prototype, not the final hardware revision), but did not pay anything for this video or have any say in its contents.
